title: Taylor Swift, Tinashe, Kenny Chesney & More: Highlights of This Week’s Billboard Charts
summary: All of Billboard’s charts update each Tuesday.
contentText:
Tuesday is new Billboard chart day each week! As all charts update each Tuesday, here’s a look at highlights of the latest rankings, dated Oct. 10 and reflecting the Sept. 25-Oct. 1 measurement week, according to data tracker Luminate.

Among this week’s chart stars are Taylor Swift , Tinashe, Kenny Chesney, Bruno Mars and the record-slaying KPop Demon Hunters .

Related

Will Taylor Swift Pass The Beatles for the Most Hot 100 No. 1 Hits?

Swift’s The Life of a Showgirl soars back to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 for a 13th total week on top, vaulting 20 spots after it was reissued with four previously unreleased songs on Sept. 25. The set debuted atop the chart dated Oct. 18, 2025 — with a single-week record 4.002 million equivalent albums earned in the United States.

The album, via its original and deluxe edition, dubbed The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore , totaled 173,000 units in the week ending Oct. 1 — up 619% week over week.

The expanded version adds the new cuts “Patient Zero” — which launches at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 as her 16th leader — “Cleveland!,” “Babylon,” and “Pink Clouding.” The latter three songs debut at Nos. 3, 4 and 5, respectively, upping Swift’s count to 74 career top 10s, the most among women.

Meanwhile, counting its original and deluxe iterations, The Life of a Showgirl now houses 14 Hot 100 top 10s — the most ever from an album.

Additionally, Swift surges back to No. 1 for a record-extending 138th week atop the Billboard Artist 100 .

Read on for more key highlights from this week’s Billboard charts below.

Additional reporting by Keith Caulfield, Russ Penuell and Trevor Anderson
